items: .projects-grid: Uses CSS Grid to create a responsive layout with one larger column for the featured project and two smaller columns for the remaining cards.
.primary-card: Styled to span two rows, making it larger and more prominent as the featured project.
tech-tag-list: Displays the tech stack tags in a flex layout, wrapping as needed on smaller screens.
Project Card Styling: Each card has a white background, shadow, and padding, creating a clean, organized look.
Responsive Elements: The grid-template-columns and grid-template-rows allow the cards to adjust effectively on different screen sizes.
